subject: Request: Priority uptime commitment for StormPeak POC
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj@stormpeak.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena@finexa.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Priority uptime commitment request for POC

Connor —

Thanks again for the demo last week. StormPeak is excited to move into a two-week pilot with Redwood next Monday (6/13). Our platform is customer-facing (real-time inference powering user workflows) and the pilot will route a subset of production traffic to Redwood.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide a short-term elevated uptime/availability commitment for the POC window? Specifically, we need an operational commitment that covers the pilot period with an availability floor of 99.9% (monthly) for the routes handling our customer traffic and a pre-agreed incident response SLA (30 min P1 acknowledgement).

Why this matters: we have three anchor customers who expect near-continuous availability during the pilot. If the pilot shows stable performance, StormPeak expects to sign a 12-month reserved capacity agreement (deal SP-2489) and expand volume materially.

Traffic profile (summary): peak ~120 QPS, average 40 QPS, mostly short sequences (~128 tokens), model: open-llama-70b-quantized variant.

Attached is a short traffic estimate and a one-page SLA ask. Can you let me know if this is feasible and what the gating/product/ops asks would be? We have flexibility on the exact wording of the commitment if it helps.

Appreciate it —
Raj Patel
Head of Platform, StormPeak AI
raj@stormpeak.ai

Team —

FYI: StormPeak (deal SP-2489) is asking for a short-term elevated availability commitment for a 2-week pilot starting 6/13. They frame this as a gating condition for a 12-month reserved capacity contract. Key points from Raj: 99.9% monthly availability floor, 30m P1 acknowledgement, traffic ~120 QPS peak, model variant: open-llama-70b-quant.

Can product / ops evaluate feasibility and list the required mitigations and config changes? Specific asks:
- Can we support a temporary higher availability SLA for the pilot without a long-term reservation in place?
- What would be the required infrastructure (dedicated pool? warm pool size? autoscale min instances?) and expected incremental cost?
- Any feature or runtime changes needed (caching priming, fallback model variants, shorter seq caps)?
- Ops: incident playbook, maintenance blackout windows, and monitoring hooks we must commit to.

I attached their traffic estimate and the one-page SLA ask. Please review and reply with a proposed internal decision by EOD today so I can loop Raj back tomorrow.

Connor O'Brien
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Connor / team —

Quick commercial context: StormPeak is a high-priority target for our platform expansion — they have strong logos and are willing to convert to reserved capacity if the pilot proves out. We should be careful to protect downside while enabling the pilot.

From sales perspective I recommend:
- Offer a time-boxed pilot commitment (two-week elevated availability) tied to explicit success criteria (error rate <1% and latency p95 <250ms for pilot traffic).
- Attach a nominal pilot fee or make the pilot free in exchange for a signed LOI for reserved capacity if the pilot metrics are met within 14 days.
- Propose a follow-up commercial review on day 10 of the pilot to agree expansion/commit.

I can negotiate credits/discounts; need product/ops inputs on feasibility and exact wording (we can't promise hardware-level HA guarantees without dedicated capacity).

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@stormpeak.ai>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority uptime commitment request for POC

Thanks — technical readout from product/serving perspective below. TL;DR: we can operationally support a time-limited elevated commitment for the pilot, but only with specific mitigations and a scoped routing footprint (not all endpoints). Details and required asks: 

1) Capacity model
- Dedicated warm pool: recommend reserving a small dedicated pool (equivalent to ~4x baseline GPU capacity for the pilot traffic peaks). This avoids cold-start and reduces autoscale risk.
- Autoscale floor: set min instances to cover steady-state (approx 2x avg QPS) with headroom for spikes.

2) Operational mitigations
- Maintenance blackout: agreed pilot window with no planned infra changes.
- Active KV/prefix caching: we must prime caches prior to cutover; ops will need a KV priming runbook.
- Fallback policy: configure automatic fallback to a smaller/quantized model variant only for non-critical routes; critical customer routes must stay on primary variant.

3) SLO and monitoring
- For pilot only we can promise 99.9% availability for scoped routes if the above are implemented and we have access to the pilot telemetry.
- We require a telemetry hook into their monitoring (or we push metrics into their dashboard) to make joint measurements.

4) Limitations / risks
- We cannot extend the elevated commitment to other global regions without additional capacity reservations.
- If the pilot load exceeds the provided traffic estimate by >25% for >2 hours, the commitment will be voided until we stabilize.

5) Implementation timeline (needs 48–72 hours prep)
- Ops prep and cache priming (24–36h)
- Dedicated pool provisioning (24h if capacity available; 72h if new provisioning required)
- Runbook & monitoring integration (24h)

Action items for commercial/ops:
- Confirm whether StormPeak will accept a scoped route list (we should limit to 3 API routes for the pilot).
- Ops: confirm availability of reserved warm pool and blackout windows.
- Legal: we need a time-boxed addendum (pilot SLA) that includes clear abort conditions and liability caps.

If we get go-ahead by EOD, product/ops can stand up the pilot configuration in time for 6/13.

Grace O'Connor
Product Manager, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@stormpeak.ai>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority uptime commitment request for POC — ops notes

Agree with Grace. Ops notes / constraints: 
- We have capacity in the us-west pool to cover a 4x warm pool for the two-week window, but it requires a short-term reservation; cost delta estimated at ~1.8x of baseline per-hour GPU cost.
- We will need an explicit maintenance blackout for 6/13–6/27 (no planned infra upgrades), and a point-of-contact in StormPeak for paging (phone + PagerDuty).
- Incident response: we can commit to 30m P1 acknowledgement if we pre-wire a dedicated on-call rotation for the pilot (will use two engineers on standby nights/weekends).
- Compliance: since they asked about availability, legal will want the addendum and a liability cap. Also request from Security: confirm no PII in the pilot traffic or we'll need an additional control set.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa: get written confirmation from Raj on scoped routes, pilot dates, and PII statement.
- Legal: I'll open a ticket for the pilot SLA addendum template.
- Connor / Grace: schedule a 45m technical cutover call with StormPeak ops tomorrow to agree runbook and priming steps.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Dedicated Ops — Redwood Inference
